description: Derived from AGSC-05-37 and AGSC-05-38: the closure also reads the site vocabulary in force. Over the graph of `graph-0044`, `dom:Engine` is a subclass of `asc:Concept`, so `engine-a`, which already has the item class `asc:Concept`, gains `skos:Concept` through it; `dom:controlled-by` and `dom:controls` are sub-properties of `asc:uses`, so each controller link gives an `asc:uses` edge, and the inverse of `asc:uses`, `asc:usedBy`, gives the edge back. The vocabulary's own triples add nothing new (prp-inv1 and prp-inv2 find the inverse pair already stated). The file is sorted by bytes and ends with one LF.
